full_review_text: This location has improved quite a bit since my last visit many years ago. It is a little more pricey than restaurants within Bangalore but not unaffordable. If you do drive to Bangalore from the airport or from anywhere beyond the Airport's Toll Gate. Do consider stopping here. Dishes: 1. Vada - 4.5 star. Good portion size and tastes as good as they look. 2. Dosa - 4 star. Not as good as the ones you'd get at Taaza Thindi or Arogya Ahaara, just to name a few. The potato filling inside is also a little bland. 3. Coffee - 5 star. You can sort of customize how much sugar and coffee you want by requesting them to do so at the coffee counter. 4. Packaged food and sweets: 5 star. .They've got a very wide range of sweets and packaged food, which is already a plus. The video of their factory and hygiene standards on YouTube assures you're not buying something poorly made. Almost on par with Haldirams (haldirams being slightly better). 5. Dinner choices in the first floor were not that great and cost higher than average prices. They were just OK enough. 6. The room (think it was called deluxe and was room no. 1) was not that good. While the price seemed alright and the room was quite spacious, there were food stains on the bedsheets, the floor had dirt, the bathroom and room in general was very outdated. It did include a mini tiffin breakfast which was kind of worth it. 7. Similar situation with the restaurant as well. There's some smell you get from frequently used cleaning cloths. The washroom needs big improvement. 8. Parking is still a minor concern during rush hour though there's enough now that the adjacent land (previously Lamborghini service centre) has opened up and there's some more parking under the metro bridge. 9. Reachability and location is quite good for those arriving or departing from/to the airport. Overall. A relatively decent place for south Indian food in the area as an alternative to "Hotel Shivaprasad Veg" near the Toll Gate for South and North Indian veg food with the bonus of packed sweets and snacks.

full_review_text: We stayed here for a day on our transit via Bangalore. We recd. a very warm welcome on arrival. There were 4 of us and while booking the room it charged us 1000 extra for the kids, however on arrival at the hotel we were told a bed would be provided immediately when needed. We were also told that the bed is king sized, however the bed is only queen sized and 2 adults and a 3 yr old can barely sleep on it. We ordered a bed for the room before lunch, however even after an hour, the bed was not provided, it took 3 calls before someone showed up finally at our door. The room is a decent sized one, however there was no ceiling fan and only a single AC vent on the left side of the room so there is no air circulation and it got pretty stuffy at times. The bathroom has a single fixed shower, not the hand shower kind so you are forced to have a full shower each time. There is no shower cap on either so we had to request a bucket and even that needed 3calls with lots of following up and 1 hr to be delivered. The hotel is located about a km inside from a side road so there are no options for eating anywhere other than the hotel. there is a restaurant inside the hotel that has breakfast and lunch, dinner buffets and they serve quite a spread. However we were never shown any menu cards for evening snacks and were charged atrocious prices for what we are ordered. The food however tasted good and the breakfast buffet was great. Service was also good in the restaurant On the pro, this hotel has Close proximity to the international airport. Takes 15 to 20 mins to get there.however most of the cab drivers had trouble finding this place. They also have a nice pool with a large projection screen by the pool which is nice to sit by .kids under 5 eat free at the buffet which is nice. Overall, we were disappointed as this was supposedly a 4 star hotel but the service was lacking and left much to be desired.

The potato masala was well-spiced, flavorful, and tasted fresh. The dosa was served hot with a generous portion of chutney and sambar, both of which complemented the dosa very well. The coconut chutney was fresh and aromatic, and the sambar had a rich, authentic South Indian taste. Every bite felt satisfying and comforting. Apart from the masala dosa, the overall menu offers a good variety of vegetarian dishes, making it suitable for breakfast, lunch, or even an early dinner stop. The quality of ingredients is clearly maintained, and the food tastes hygienic and freshly prepared. Portion sizes are good, and the pricing feels reasonable for the quality and location. The service is quick and efficient, which is especially important for highway travelers. The staff are polite and attentive, ensuring orders are served promptly even during busy hours. The restaurant and washroom areas are clean and well-maintained, adding to the overall positive experience. Overall, Koteshwaram – The Temple of Divine Food lives up to its name. Great taste, especially the masala dosa, convenient highway location, good service, and a clean environment make it a 5-star experience for me. The eatery offers ample parking space, making it an ideal pit stop for travelers. It features a well-maintained front yard garden that adds to its charm. For those looking to spend quality time, there are options for fine dining, providing an elegant and comfortable atmosphere. On the other hand, for quick travelers, there is a traditional self-service Darshini type setup, perfect for grabbing a quick coffee or simply using the washroom facilities. The aloo filling was seasoned with just the right amount of saltiness, and the accompanying chutney and sambhar complemented the dosas beautifully, creating a harmonious blend of flavors. We also tried the bonda soup, which was a delightful surprise. Typically, one bonda is served, but we were pleasantly surprised to receive two. While I expected it to be a bit spicier and more peppery, it was still incredibly delicious and satisfying. To conclude our evening snack, we enjoyed a cup of coffee that was creamy and fresh, perfectly hitting the right spots and leaving us refreshed. The staff at the eatery were exceptionally friendly and welcoming. They did not rush us to leave even after we had settled the bill, allowing us to relax and decompress on the property. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we had a great time enjoying the food and ambiance.

full_review_text: We went to this Samara Veg especially for breakfast at the Chikkaballapur branch. We had previously visited their other outlet, around 40 km further ahead, and had an amazing experience, so we decided to drive from Bengaluru to try this one as well. Thankfully, this branch did not disappoint either! I really appreciated the thoughtful little touches here — mint lemon water, a wheelchair ramp, a mini washbasin for kids in the washroom, and a kids’ play area. These may seem like small things, but they make the place feel much more welcoming and family-friendly. The food was tasty and lived up to our expectations. We ordered Pongal, masala dosa, rava idli, kesari bath, tea, and jaggery coffee. The Pongal was different from what is usually served at their other outlet, but in a refreshing and delicious way. The masala dosa was slightly cold, but still tasty. Rava idli was good, and the kesari bath was absolutely delicious. The tea was a little too sweet for my liking, but otherwise tasted good. The jaggery coffee was a nice addition. It had a good coffee flavour without being overly sweet, so the sweetness didn’t overpower the coffee. The washrooms were clean, and the overall place was hygienic, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed. The only area that could be improved is the service speed. Placing the order and sometimes having to repeat it can get a little frustrating. However, once the order is placed correctly, the food is served quite quickly. Overall, it was definitely worth the drive from Bengaluru. A nice place for a family breakfast, with good food, clean surroundings, and some thoughtful touches that make the experience better. Would happily visit again! If you want, I can also make this **shorter and more punchy for a Google review**, while keeping the same points.

full_review_text: Big Bay, India, is a traveler's paradise, tucked away on the Bangalore-Hyderabad Highway (around 90km from Bglr) and very ideal for pit stop. The environment offers a much-needed break from the road, the cuisine selection pleases all palates, and the facilities are immaculate. It is the highest quality, whether you are having a leisurely meal or a fast coffee. Big Bay India sets the bar high for highway stops. Update 5th Aug 2024 (Second visit) : On the way back from Lepakshi, we made a lunch break at Big Bay. The space is spacious, tidy, well-kept, and well-organized. There are numerous culinary selections. Empire was our choice and the food was good. Parking/Restroom: There is plenty of room for parking, which is convenient for people who are arriving by bus or car. They even offer a kids' area, EV charging, and a Jio fuel station. An important consideration for long-distance visitors is the restrooms in Big Bay, which are kept in excellent condition. Outlets : Empire, Starbucks, KFC, Burger King, Baskin-Robbins, GoPizza, Leon's, Haldiram’s , Ajfan Dates & Nuts , etc and many more to come .

washroom_snippet: I had an excellent experience at this petrol pump with a fantastic range of restaurant options and top-notch washroom facilities.
full_review_text: I had an excellent experience at this petrol pump with a fantastic range of restaurant options and top-notch washroom facilities. The variety of restaurant choices in this food court made it easy to find something for each one of us in a group of 4, and the overall atmosphere was very hygienic, extremely aesthetically appealing and welcoming. We had an assortment of food from Haldirams, KFC, Burger King, Starbucks and Empire. I have traveled the length and breath of India and have seen very few if none matching this standard The cleanliness and upkeep of the washrooms were impressive and best in class – akin more to 5 star hotels than petrol bunks on the highway, providing a level of comfort and convenience not found at petrol stations/restaurants in India. We also filled fuel here and the staff was very pleasant and courteous to deal with. I highly recommend this to anyone passing by for fuel and food. Wish there were more options like this on all highways. It would make life simpler.
